observedCapabilities.discovery: Machine-first discovery API returning ranked x402 endpoints by capability.
observedCapabilities.paidVerification: EntRoute states that top endpoints are further tested with real paid requests to confirm useful data after payment.

evidenceLimits.note: EntRoute's published success/latency and paid-canary claims are competitor evidence only. They are not James benchmark results or live execution quotes.

killCriterion3.reason: Public evidence reviewed does not clearly show identical locked-task deterministic correctness/acceptability tests, task-specific post-purchase success probability, paid retry history, or retry-adjusted expected cost per acceptable result driving the machine route.

implicationForJames: Generic x402 endpoint discovery, continuous 402 verification, reliability/latency/price ranking and even real-paid canary verification should now be treated as commodity infrastructure. Outcome Economics Intelligence must prove exact-task deterministic post-purchase acceptability and execution-time retry-adjusted cost per acceptable result, then change the buying decision versus cheapest/healthiest/cheapest-live baselines.
